mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ebus_picklist (biz_id, user_id, run_id, template_id, disclaimer, assumptions, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{bizId}, #{userId}, #{runId}, #{templateId}, #{disclaimer}, #{assumptions}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO ebus_picklist_item (biz_id, picklist_id, sort_order, title, price_band, reason, differentiation, demand, competition, margin, risk, created_at) VALUES (#{bizId}, #{picklistId}, #{sortOrder}, #{title}, #{priceBand}, #{reason}, #{differentiation}, #{demand}, #{competition}, #{margin}, #{risk}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, biz_id, picklist_id, sort_order, title, price_band, reason, differentiation, demand, competition, margin, risk, created_at FROM ebus_picklist_item WHERE picklist_id = #{picklistId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
